'''Chris Fanchi The Son Of Skywalker Must Become A Jedi''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Chris Fanchi]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-8812">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8812 The Son Of Skywalker Must Become A Jedi], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 27 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8812/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8812/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018145205/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8812/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''The Son Of Skywalker Must Become A Jedi'''
* '''Author:''' Chris "Artwo" Fanchi
* '''Published:''' July 27, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Train Luke and then whip out the fearsome foursome.

=== Strategy ===

A pretty straight-forward Jedi testing deck. We all know the trick to testing, so I won't go into that (obviously use Insight to get The Way Of Things).

Vs. Any DS Space Deck- Get your mains with their special effects onto the Home One and just do a beatdown. With Jedi Test 4, It isn't hard to get the effects out. (plus using I Wonder Who They Found).

Vs. Any Ground Deck- Use your mains for an easy beatdown then drain them to death wwith your lightsabers.

Chris "ARTWO" Fanchi
